usedFor: Mailparser pulls structured data out of emails, and Freshsales Classic opens a deal with “Create Deal” after “New Email Parsed”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A parsed enquiry or order becomes a deal linked to an account, and the contact is created if missing.

watchOut: “Create Deal” sets stage and expected close date, so confirm your parsed emails carry values for them.
